name: Lace Chair Back Cover
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from soft sheer mesh for a lightweight, elegant, and airy look.
    - Finished with a delicate lace trim, 8 cm ~ 3.15 in wide.
    - Equipped with sturdy metal grommets for secure ribbon attachment.
    - Includes decorative satin ribbons for easy installation and a polished finish.
    - Designed to drape beautifully over chair backs for weddings and special events.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 45 × 33 cm ~ 17.72 × 12.99 in
    - Printable area: 27.94 × 12.7 cm ~ 11 × 5 in
    📌 Note: Manual measurement may result in a size variation of ±3 cm.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality heat transfer printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Features one-sided printing on the sheer mesh fabric.
    📌 Note:
    - Colors may vary by up to 5% between the mockup and the finished product.
    - Neon colors, metallic colors, and special effects are not supported and cannot be accurately reproduced during printing.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Designed to decorate the back of chairs for weddings, receptions, parties, and formal events.
    - Easy to install by placing the cover over the chair back and tying the satin ribbons through the metal grommets.
    - Adjustable ribbon ties help secure the cover and create a neat draped look.
    - Lightweight fabric is easy to arrange, remove, fold, and store after use.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Perfect for weddings, bridal showers, engagement parties, anniversaries, and vow renewals.
    - Ideal for personalized Bride & Groom, Mr. & Mrs., Just Married, reserved seating, or sweetheart-chair décor.
    - Also suitable for baby showers, birthdays, graduation parties, romantic dinners, and elegant event styling.
    - A beautiful reusable decoration for venues, event planners, photographers, and home celebrations.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 8 – 15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Lace Chair Back Cover

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow  3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
